mapper.select: SELECT id AS missionId, title, description, mission_type AS missionType, trigger_event AS triggerEvent, target_count AS targetCount, reward_point AS rewardPoint, created_at AS createdAt FROM mission
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mission (title, description, mission_type, trigger_event, target_count, reward_point) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{missionType}, #{triggerEvent}, #{targetCount}, #{rewardPoint})
mapper.update: UPDATE mission SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, mission_type = #{missionType}, trigger_event = #{triggerEvent}, target_count = #{targetCount}, reward_point = #{rewardPoint} WHERE id = #{missionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_mission (user_id, mission_id, status, current_count) SELECT #{userId}, id, 'READY', 0 FROM mission;
INSERT INTO user_mission (user_id, mission_id, status, current_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{missionId}, 'READY', 0)
mapper.select: SELECT um.id AS id, um.user_id AS userId, um.mission_id AS missionId, um.status, um.current_count AS progressCount, um.reward_received AS rewardReceived, um.updated_at AS completedAt, m.target_count AS targetCount, m.title, m.description, m.reward_point AS rewardPoint FROM user_mission um JOIN mission m ON um.mission_id = m.id WHERE um.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT um.id AS id, um.user_id AS userId, um.mission_id AS missionId, um.status, um.current_count AS progressCount, um.reward_received AS rewardReceived, um.updated_at AS completedAt, m.target_count AS targetCount, m.title, m.description, m.reward_point AS rewardPoint FROM user_mission um JOIN mission m ON um.mission_id = m.id WHERE um.user_id = #{userId} AND um.mission_id = #{missionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_history (user_id, mission_id, point, reason, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{missionId}, #{rewardPoint}, #{type}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT um.id AS id, um.user_id AS userId, um.mission_id AS missionId, um.status, um.current_count AS progressCount, um.reward_received AS rewardReceived, m.target_count AS targetCount, m.reward_point AS rewardPoint FROM user_mission um JOIN mission m ON um.mission_id = m.id WHERE um.user_id = #{userId} AND m.trigger_event = #{triggerEvent} AND um.status = 'PROGRESS'
